title: Collect the admissions and amusement tax
summary: Counties and towns tax admission charges and amusement fees. The {{county}} rate is {{admissionsRate}} (state table for fiscal year 2026).
action: Register with the Comptroller of Maryland and file admissions and amusement tax returns, even for periods with no taxable receipts.
frequencyNote: Filing schedule set by the Comptroller
sourceName: Department of Legislative Services: 2026 County Local Tax Rates

title: Collect the hotel rental tax
summary: Counties tax room rentals. The {{county}} hotel rental tax rate is {{hotelRate}} (state table for fiscal year 2026).
action: Contact the {{county}} finance office to register and learn its filing schedule.
frequencyNote: Filing schedule set by your county
sourceName: Department of Legislative Services: 2026 County Local Tax Rates
